page_title: EMP 0-1 BOL | Empoli v Bologna 15/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
90+7' Remo Freuler (Bologna) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90+6' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected. Youssef Maleh (Empoli) will miss the next game.

90+4' 0 - 1 Riccardo Calafiori fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) inside the box. He releases a quick shot into the bottom right corner. The score is now 0:1.
90+1' Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
88' The game is interrupted now, Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
86' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
84' A pass into the box finds Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Elia Caprile denies him.
83' Elia Caprile displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Santiago Castro (Bologna) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
81' A corner kick by Bologna is thwarted by the well prepared Elia Caprile (Empoli).
81' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Elia Caprile pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. Bologna win a corner.
79' Thiago Motta decides to make a substitution. Lewis Ferguson will be replaced by Michel Aebischer (Bologna).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) comes onto the pitch for Kacper Urbanski.
79' Razvan Marin (Empoli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

78' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The linesman points to the corner flag, Empoli are going to take it.
77' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.

76' Tommaso Corazza (Bologna) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
75' Here is a change. Nicolo Cambiaghi is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Alberto Cerri (Empoli).
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Francesco Caputo (Empoli) is coming onto the pitch as M'Baye Niang cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. That's a free kick to Bologna.
72' Thiago Motta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tommaso Corazza (Bologna) replacing Sam Beukema.
72' Substitution. Santiago Castro (Bologna) replaces Jens Odgaard.
71' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 10:13. The number of shots on goal at present is 1:4.

67' That didn't go as planned! M'Baye Niang (Empoli) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Lukasz Skorupski, who easily kept it out.
66' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) replaces Emmanuel Gyasi.
66' The substitution has been made. Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) has replaced Szymon Zurkowski.
65' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
61' A pass by Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
60' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar.
57' Substitution. Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) has come on for Dan Ndoye.
56' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) meets a cross from Razvan Marin, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes high over the crossbar.
56' Razvan Marin (Empoli) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
53' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) picks up the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well over the crossbar and ends in the stands.
52' Razvan Marin (Empoli) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
51' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
51' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Empoli have a corner.
50' Razvan Marin (Empoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
49' The opposition give Razvan Marin (Empoli) far too much space and he has a go from long range, but the goal isn't threatened as the ball goes well wide of the left post.
48' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
46' Davide Nicola makes a half-time substitution. Liberato Cacace (Empoli) comes on in place of Giuseppe Pezzella.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' Michael Fabbri has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
44' The corner kick is deflected to Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli), who immediately sends in a long-range shot. However, he hits the ball poorly and it goes high over the bar.
44' Razvan Marin (Empoli) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
43' Good defending. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) tries to find M'Baye Niang inside the box, but the pass is cut out.

39' The opposition back off Dan Ndoye (Bologna), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but Elia Caprile denies him with the save.
38' The total number of attempts is 3:10. 0:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
34' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) is caught off guard a bit when the ball lands at his feet, causing him to rush a first-time shot that is easily blocked by an opposition player.
32' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
30' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) was quite harsh and Michael Fabbri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
30' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
28' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
27' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Michael Fabbri who sees an offensive foul.
26' Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) is lurking on the edge of the box and receives a pass from M'Baye Niang. He shows nice control before hitting a soft shot just wide of the left post.

25' Razvan Marin (Empoli) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick just outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
23' Razvan Marin (Empoli) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

19' Elia Caprile pulls off a great save to deny Sam Beukema (Bologna), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal. Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
19' The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.

18' What a great chance for Sam Beukema (Bologna). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Elia Caprile shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
18' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

17' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
17' Bologna players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
15' Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Jens Odgaard, but Elia Caprile displays great awareness to stop him.
14' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) sends a long ball forward to Nicolo Cambiaghi, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.

10' A nice cross arrived in the box from the corner kick and found the head of Sam Beukema (Bologna). He steered the ball towards the right post, but one of the defenders is there to cover the goalkeeper and keep it out.
10' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

9' That's unlucky! Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
8' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
6' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) receives a pass then lets rip from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Elia Caprile watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
5' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Razvan Marin (Empoli) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

4' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Empoli.
2' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bologna was in an offside position.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Empoli will take the kick-off.
Michael Fabbri will supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
